name: Berber vs Plush: Which Carpet Wears Better
title-tag: Berber vs Plush Carpet: Which Wears Better | Mukilteo WA
meta-description: Berber's loops hide traffic but snag; plush is soft but shows footprints and mats. Loop vs cut construction, claws, stairs — and which rooms want which.
post-summary: January 21, 2027 · Berber and plush are one manufacturing choice apart: loops left intact or sheared open. Loops resist crushing but one caught claw can pull a run; cut pile is soft and snag-proof but mats in the traffic lanes. How wear, pets and stairs pick the winner room by room.
